versions.label: Version 5
versions.status: Draft: Version 5 from Sam's Revise request of 5 November (18:30 UTC): the Overview gains The CPL Initiative at a glance after the December 9 call, four numbered steps from a student's learning to another college adopting the credit (Learning; Request, through Credit for Being You; Credit, which the college awards in MAP; Adoption), with the Chancellor's Office CPL page and the CPL Fact Sheet linked, and the call's second agenda item links to it. To keep Sierra reading the page whole, 14 table cells now read No credit recommendation yet and 7 precedent lines drop already: 33,971 characters against her 34,000. Then, at Sam's ask in session, the top cards open what they count: the funding opens the note naming EDD's award notice, the 7 projects open the fit bands, the 15 credential families open the statewide table; the participants card stays plain, since its figure sums one line on each of six project tabs. Remediated: nothing failed; npm run a11y and an axe pass of every tab at 390px and 1440px, light and dark, passed.
